source_method.name: M-GRPO
source_method.paper: Multi-Agent Deep Research: Training Multi-Agent Systems with M-GRPO

scope_reason: M-GRPO changes planner/sub-agent credit, trajectory alignment, execution frequency, and cross-server coordination. It is therefore audited as a complete agentic recipe, not mislabeled as a minimal arithmetic loss hook.

shared_stack.scaffold: one fixed planner plus fixed multi-turn tool-executor interface

arms.single_agent_grpo: one trainable policy handles planning and tools
arms.multi_agent_frozen_subagents: train planner with GRPO; sub-agent policies frozen
arms.mgrpo: train planner and sub-agent policies with hierarchical group-relative credit, trajectory alignment, and the declared decoupled update protocol

primary_endpoint: heldout task success per million generated action tokens
secondary_endpoints: planner and sub-agent effective gradient mass

analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction for the two M-GRPO-versus-control primary comparisons
analysis.refusal_rule: No verdict unless all three arms and all five seeds pass manifest and budget checks.

execution_blocker: Requires a multi-agent training implementation, sandboxed tool environment, and accelerator budget; none is claimed in this repository revision.
